jobs.title: Policy Fellow or Senior Policy Fellow, US Development Policy Program
jobs.reason: Location is DC with no London option, and under a London-only filter this is excluded. It is also a Fellow / Senior Fellow role well above entry level.

jobs.title: Fellow, Climate policy & development
jobs.reason: A "Fellow" role at a policy institute is not entry-level and typically requires several years of subject expertise the candidate lacks. Climate development policy also sits outside the candidate's core interest zones.

jobs.title: Freelance Auditor Food
jobs.reason: Multiple hard disqualifiers apply: it requires a food-industry degree, 5+ years of food-sector experience, a 3rd-party auditing qualification, and fluent Dutch and French — none of which the candidate has. The role is entirely outside the candidate's field and skill set.

jobs.title: Lead Assessor
jobs.reason: Not entry-level — the role requires 3–4 years of social compliance auditing experience plus 200+ verifiable audit days and industry certifications the candidate lacks. It is a specialist auditing job outside the candidate's research/policy profile, so even setting aside the level, it is a poor fit.

jobs.title: Trainer and Consultant
jobs.reason: The role requires essential technical expertise in the Pressure Equipment Directive plus a recognised training-delivery qualification and proven training competency the candidate plainly lacks — it is aimed at experienced consultants and management experts, not an early-career applicant. It is also entirely outside the candidate's interest zones. This is an industrial-assurance training contract, a hard mismatch on both level and skills.
